item.text:
Added the async server component [preferences-display.tsx](/workspace/app/preferences-display.tsx). It reads the `theme` cookie, defaults to `light`, and displays the first language from the `Accept-Language` header (or “Not specified” when the header is absent). The home page now renders it.

I didn’t run tests. `package.json` and `package-lock.json` also have workspace changes that I left untouched.
